title: X6887-16.3.0.150SP21-OP009PF001AZ-16.3.0.160SP02-OP003PF001AZ_20261015111507
description:
If the battery level is below 30%, please charge your device to at least 30% before installing the OTA update.

Update Version:
16.3.0.160SP02(OP003PF001AZ)

Smoothness
· Optimized for the occasional lag occurred when unlocking with a PIN, making the unlock experience smoother.
· Improved animation smoothness when opening the Recent album, making page transitions smoother.
· Improved animation smoothness when exiting home screen edit mode.
· Improved responsiveness and animation smoothness when swiping down to open AI Search after unlocking.

Stability
· Fixed the occasional issue where the launcher could stop responding when swapping split-screen apps.
· Fixed the occasional issue where the screen could freeze after the Messages screen slid out to the side in split-screen mode activated with the gesture.
· Fixed the issue where apps could occasionally restart unexpectedly when multiple apps were kept running in the background, improving background stability.

Home Screen & Control Center
· Fixed the issue where the notification dot could occasionally remain after an OTA update was installed.
· Fixed the issue where the home screen data plan widget would occasionally fail to update the remaining data after mobile data was used.
· Fixed the occasional issue where the incoming call pop-up would not appear at the top of the screen when the screen was on, making calls easier to answer.

Security
· Updated Google Security Patch to October 2026 to enhance system security.

More Functional Optimizations
· Improved Find My Phone location accuracy by reducing positioning deviation.
· Fixed the issue where ringtones could revert to the default after a system update. Custom alarm ringtones now remain unchanged after updates.
· Fixed the issue in the Recorder app where recording files could occasionally be lost after the screen turned off and the phone was later unlocked. Recordings are now saved more reliably.

Reminding:
· Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
· Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
